title: Ubuntu Podcast: episodes, facts, and feedback form
stressor: data table, infobox sidebar, labelled form inputs
attribution: Original markup for the Nyala corpus; facts drawn from the Ubuntu Podcast Wikipedia page.
notes: Self-contained single page, all CSS inline, no script, no network URLs. Designed for a 960x640 viewport (120x40 at 8x16). Three layout stressors on one page: a bordered episodes data table with right-aligned numeric columns and varying-width presenter cells, an infobox-style box floated right with label/value rows (Presenters, Language, Years active), and a feedback form with a text input, email input, select, checkbox, and submit button. Headings label each section. White background, dark text. Markup is original; facts are drawn from the Ubuntu Podcast Wikipedia page and not copied verbatim. British English copy.
